card.name: Verbs and articles before event nouns
card.fires_on: Small words like "a" and "the" and verbs like staged, passed, approves or announced in news-style or history text, right before the thing that was done is named.

modes.label: Article before an action noun
modes.description: The word "a" or "the" right after a verb, just before an event or document noun.
modes.example: The High Court of AP passed<< a>> judgement in 2001.

modes.label: Reporting verb
modes.description: A verb of announcing, approving or staging, where the object comes next.
modes.example: Tacoma City Council<< approves>> Chinese Reconciliation Resolution on November 3

card.writes: Weak effect; it slightly favors words like Suite, letter and International and disfavors unrelated tokens.
